title: Servicing Standard for Farm Real Estate Loans: Automatic Debit Instructions
content:
## Clauses in force

**1. Member's own instruction.** Automatic debit of installments on a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage is authorised, moved or cancelled only on the member's own instruction, the checking account being identified by the last four digits the member gives, recorded exactly as given.

**2. Loan status.** Autopay may be changed only while the loan is in active or nonaccrual status, as shown on the loan's own system record.

**3. Debit date.** Each installment is then debited on its due date.

**4. Product terms.** Whether automatic debit is available, and the autopay discount, are those of each FarmLand product's discount schedule.

## Clause no longer in force

> The clause "The autopay discount of the contract rate-setting rules is added or removed from the change date; moving the debit to another account leaves the rate unchanged." is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Points of judgement

| Situation | Under clauses 1 to 3 |
|---|---|
| The member instructs the change personally | the change may be made |
| Someone other than the member asks for the change | not made on that request |
| Loan in active or nonaccrual status | autopay may be changed |
| Loan in paid-off, applied or declined status | autopay may not be changed |
| Member gives the last four digits 0427 | the account is recorded as 0427, exactly as given |

superseded_clauses: The autopay discount of farmland_rate_setting is added or removed from the change date; moving the debit to another account leaves the rate unchanged.
